investment_details: BBG Corp. offers investment access through Preferred Shares and Limited Partnership Units. Open to both Canadian accredited investors and select international investors. Canadian investors can hold investments inside a TFSA (tax-free growth) or RRSP (tax-deferred growth). Preferred shareholders receive eligible dividends — taxed more favourably than interest income. International investors may benefit from Canada's tax treaties. To invest: schedule a consultation call, complete KYC and accreditation documents, sign a subscription agreement, and wire funds. For specific investment minimums, dividend rates, and available tranches, please contact us at investors@bluebeargroup.ca or +1 437 826 4847.

faqs.q: What is the minimum investment amount?
faqs.a: Our investment minimums vary depending on the share class or Limited Partnership unit structure. We'd be happy to walk you through the options during a complimentary consultation — please reach out to us at investors@bluebeargroup.ca or call +1 437 826 4847.

Investors receive eligible dividends through BBG's Preferred Share structure. Distributions are paid directly to your registered account or bank account. For the specific distribution schedule and rates applicable to current opportunities, we invite you to book a consultation with our team.

faqs.q: Is my investment TFSA or RRSP eligible?
faqs.a: Yes — BBG Preferred Shares are eligible to be held inside a TFSA for tax-free growth, or an RRSP for tax-deferred growth. We always recommend consulting your financial advisor to confirm eligibility for your specific account and situation.

Yes, BBG warmly welcomes international investors. Canada has tax treaties with many countries that may reduce withholding tax on eligible dividends. We recommend consulting a qualified tax professional in your home country for personalised guidance.

faqs.q: How does the property acquisition process work?
faqs.a: BBG conducts thorough due diligence on every property — evaluating NOI, IRR, cash-on-cash returns, neighbourhood trends, vacancy rates, and rental demand. We target 'Value-Plus' opportunities in Canada's fastest-growing urban centres. Only properties meeting our strict criteria are acquired, and investors receive regular updates on portfolio performance.

faqs.q: What makes BBG different from other real estate investments?
faqs.a: BBG combines institutional-grade due diligence with accessible investment structures. We focus on tech-integrated, community-focused multifamily properties in Canada's strongest rental markets. Our Preferred Share model provides income stability and priority status over common shareholders — giving investors a lower-risk, passive exposure to Canadian real estate without any landlord responsibilities.

By 2030, BBG aims to lead the Canadian multifamily real estate market in Canada's top 5 fastest-growing cities. Our mission is to actively address Canada's housing needs by developing and acquiring sustainable, high-quality, affordable rental properties — while delivering superior, purpose-driven returns for our investors.

faqs.q: What properties does BBG currently hold?
faqs.a: Our portfolio includes The 311 de la Grande-Côte I — a 5-unit quintuplex in Saint-Eustache, Quebec, well-positioned near the REM transit line connecting to downtown Montreal. We are also developing The Creekside Circle I in Leduc, Alberta — a 10-unit townhome project near Edmonton International Airport, with completion estimated for mid-2026. We continue to source new acquisitions across Canada's high-demand urban markets.
